surface_calibration.notes: Surface-level calibration for benign hard cases that contain security-sensitive words in defensive, training, compliance, or remediation framing. Active jailbreak/injection cues override this attenuation.

safe_frame_embedding_mlp.notes: Private in-process MLP over Qwen3 clean embedding + surface + length. The full embedding is not serialized in API metadata; only score/threshold/decision are exposed.

surface_score_calibrator.notes: Disabled after v10/v5 blind testing because it over-suppressed chat/agent active recall. Kept as an ablation artifact.

segment_aware_dual_head.notes: Pooled segment-aware dual-head v5b fine-tuned from the v5 active-request checkpoint. Adds a small runbook/OCR hard suite and excludes v8/adaptive-v3, v9/adaptive-v4, v10/adaptive-v5, and v11/adaptive-v6 locked heldouts.

profile_selector.notes: v5e suppression selector. Uses v5b strict as default, frozen v5d role escalation for hard active intent, and a learned suppression head for agent/tool hold_queue benign cases.

learned_safe_frame_adapter.notes: Learned multilingual safe-frame adapter. Low score means quoted/evaluation/defensive framing; high score means active reveal/forward/execute behavior. It gates route recovery before pattern fallback.

safe_review_allow.notes: For chat/default, only adapter-only conflicts with very low online risk can be recovered. For RAG/VLM, online-high adapter-low conflicts can be recovered only when adapter score is below 0.35 and the text has strong quoted-example framing such as risk example, should not be executed, classification example, or preserved evidence. Continuation cues override this allow.

active_route_override.notes: If an allow route still contains active reveal/disclose/forward/execute cues, escalate back to review unless a strong quoted-example safe frame cancels the cue. Generic 'defensive training' wording is not enough to cancel active attack cues.

route_allow_merge_recovery.notes: If the embedding route is already allow with low embedding risk, cap final GuardX merge risk for RAG/VLM safe-frame cases unless strong input/context guard labels are present. This prevents base lexical guards from rewriting quoted non-executable safety examples.

external_calibration.notes: External-benign/domain-harm calibration adapter. Runtime uses triage: block if Qwen3 online and adapter are both high; allow if both low; route conflicts to review/rewrite/fallback instead of hard allow.

agent_active_dispatch_route_override.notes: Narrow safety net for agent/tool dispatch=true or replay=true active tool-use cases that escape the frozen v5d escalation head.

review_fallback.notes: Optional LLM judge for conflict route only. Disabled by default and reads credentials from environment variables such as GUARDX_REVIEW_LLM_API_KEY; do not store API keys in this file.

notes: Research online profile: text -> Qwen3 embedding -> clipped Gaussian noise -> relation-aware GRU/T5 inversion-aware denoiser -> two-stage clean-logit risk adapter. Keep DistilBERT cache policy as active competition runtime unless explicitly switched.

locked.protocol: Freeze v5e suppression selector before generating fresh v15/adaptive v10. No tuning on v15/v10.
